name: PT Kencana Energi Lestari Tbk
summary: PT Kencana Energi Lestari Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a renewable energy company in Indonesia. It operates through 5 reportable segments: The 3x6 MW hydroelectric powerplant in Pakkat (North Sumatera), The 3x7 MW hydroelectric powerplant in Air Putih (Bengkulu), The 2x5 MW hydroelectric powerplant in Madong (South Sulawesi), The 2x5 MW hydroelectric powerplant in Ordi Hulu (North Sumatera), and The 2x5 MW hydroelectric powerplant in Salu Noling (South Sulawesi). The company was founded in 2008 and is based in Jakarta Barat, Indonesia.
